basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old tech enthusiast living in Seattle. My love for gadgets and weather tracking has led me to CARROTweather, where I enjoy discussing app features and updates. By day, I work as a software developer at a mid-sized tech company, and by night, I'm a D&D Dungeon Master. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy hiking and exploring new restaurants in the city. My online hours are typically late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Computer Science degree from the University of Washington, I've always been passionate about technology. My expertise in software development is mostly self-taught and honed through years of working on personal projects and professional experience.
